不定积分 $\int\frac{\ln(x^2-1)}{\sqrt{x+1}}\,dx$ 的值为（ ） $2\sqrt{x+1}[\ln(x^2-1)-4]-4\sqrt2\ln\frac{\sqrt{x+1}-\sqrt2}{x-1}+C$ $2\sqrt{x+1}[\ln(x^2-1)-4]-4\sqrt2\ln\frac{\sqrt{x+1}-2\sqrt2}{x-1}+C$ $2\sqrt{x+1}[\ln(x^2-1)-4]-2\sqrt2\ln\frac{\sqrt{x+1}}{x-1}+C$ $2\sqrt{x+1}[\ln(x^2-1)-4]-4\sqrt2\ln(\sqrt{x+1}-\sqrt2)+C$ 令$x+1=t^2$，$dx=2t\,dt$，$x^2-1=t^2(t^2-2)$，则得

$$I=2\int[\ln(t^2)+\ln(t^2-2)]dt=4\int\ln t\,dt+2\int\ln(t^2-2)dt=4(t\ln t-t)+2\int[\ln(t-\sqrt{2})+\ln(t+\sqrt{2})]dt$$

$$=2\sqrt{x+1}[\ln(x^2-1)-4]-4\sqrt{2}\ln\frac{\sqrt{x+1}-\sqrt{2}}{x-1}+C$$
